name: Korn's Campground (Town of Wallkill)
evidence: NYS leaf-off ortho + Esri at 41.5118,-74.4715 and USGS topo: Shawangunk Kill runs in a wooded ravine ~80 m W of the office and ~150 m N of the top loop, downslope through forest; the operator's sketch map (river drawn along the top, no scale) is an overview only - not waterfront

name: Niagara Shores Campground & Conference Center
evidence: Esri 240 m frame at 43.3450,-78.6806: RV area on the Lake Ontario bluff top, riprap and a brushy/treed bank down to the water; operator RV photos show rigs on the bluff behind a fence with the lake below through trees - 'waters edge' is the bluff edge, lakeview

name: Pine Ridge Park Campsite
evidence: Operator per-site map (PineRidge_CampMap_8.5x11_v3.pdf): Meadow Circle sites ~4-16 and Brad's Bog 1-5 line the Salmon River bank; rate sheet sells 'Deluxe Waterfront - Water and Electric' and 'Waterfront - No Hookups' RV sites; Franklin Co. Apr 2024 0.3 m ortho at 44.9410,-74.3785: open meadow runs unscreened to both banks of the bend, a fire-ring site ~20 m from the E bank

name: Luzerne Campground
evidence: DEC map luzerne23.pdf: sites 81/113/114/116 (RA: drive-in, 30 ft RV) on the Fourth Lake E shore; canopy-blind Esri/leaf-off; USGS lidar: shore strip drops ~10-15 m (204-210 m bench to 194 m lake) in the last ~25-30 m - a climb-down; RA site photos of 81/114/116 show the lake below through the trees - lakeview

name: Rogers Rock Campground
evidence: DEC map rogersrock23.pdf: site 4 on the lake side of the shore road by moorings MB21-22; RA site 004 (drive-in, 30 ft RV): official photos show its pad and table on open grass running ~10 m to the Lake George edge; lidar ~4 m above lake on a gentle slope; sites 255/257 lakeview across road/day-use lawn
